title: Creekside Landing Marina
specs: Rustic, park-like environment with excellent shade
Floating slips capable of handling up to 30’ of high water
All boaters must carry private insurance on their boats
Strongly encouraged to wear life jackets when paddling alone or in poor conditions
No live-aboards allowed, but overnight and weekending encouraged

options.name: Rowing Shell and Long Kayak Storage

services.name: Rowing Shell and Long Kayak Storage

includes: Private launching ramp for jet skis and small boats, no charge
Hose for cleaning boats at launching dock
Gazebo, picnic area, grill, campfire ring with free firewood
gap: Price for boat slip rental not stated
blurb: Guests can rent floating dock boat slips suitable for boats up to 30' and store kayaks, canoes, and rowing shells. The marina offers seasonal rentals with amenities including free WiFi, ice machine, porta potties, and a private launching ramp. The setting is rustic and peaceful, with a caring boating community and facilities like a gazebo, picnic area, and campfire ring.
tags: Rowing Shell and Long Kayak Storage
extraNote: Contracts renew automatically unless cancellation is notified · $200 deposit due when space becomes available for boat slips · Balance payable over March, April and May for summer season · Discounted rate for early payment by March 1 or October 15 · Avoid paddling on Harrods Creek and Ohio River when there is current and debris due to life-threatening challenges · Marina located at 6511 River Road, Prospect, KY; private gated facility, appointment required for tours · Summer (May 1 - Oct 31); Winter (Nov 1 - Apr 30)
